newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger confirms NZ parliament opening December 12.
newsitem.headline: Bolger confirms NZ parliament opening December 12.

text.p: New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger confirmed on Thursday that parliament would reconvene next Thursday, December 12, at 11 a.m.
The State Opening will be on the following day at 10 a.m.

Parliament will be meeting for the first time since the October 12 general election, and parties are trying to finalise a coalition deal before it sits. The conservative National Party and Labour both aim to form a government with the support of nationalist New Zealand First.
"It is likely the House will not sit after the State Opening until a date in February 1997 which will be nominated in an adjournment motion," Bolger said.
The House is required to resume in 1997 no later than February 25.
